release_notes.en-US:
Version 1.11 — audio-based ad detection (beta, macOS)

Some live streams (e.g. Zee5 live cricket) splice ads straight into the video with no on-page banner and no separate ad request, so the normal detectors can't catch them. This release adds an optional audio detector that listens to your Mac's audio output and mutes when the live-sport crowd ambience drops out (an ad), then unmutes when the match returns.

- Off by default; opt in from the popup ("Audio ad detection (beta)").
- macOS only, and it needs a small companion helper that the Add-ons store can't bundle. It is do-it-yourself: build and install it from the project repo (requires Xcode command line tools): https://github.com/cshintov/streaming-ad-muter#audio-ad-detection-beta-macos-only
- This version adds the "nativeMessaging" permission, used only to talk to that helper. On update Firefox will ask you to approve "Exchange messages with programs other than Firefox" — that's this feature.

The existing ad muting for Hotstar, SonyLIV and Zee5 continues to work for everyone with no extra setup.

version.approval_notes:
v1.11 adds an OPTIONAL, off-by-default audio ad-detection feature for live streams that server-side splice ads into the video (no DOM overlay, no distinguishable ad-pod network request), which the existing DOM/network detectors cannot catch. macOS only.

NATIVE MESSAGING
- The extension calls runtime.connectNative("com.devopsbytes.admute") only when the user enables "Audio ad detection (beta)" in the popup (off by default).
- The native host is a separate, user-installed helper. It is NOT and cannot be bundled in the XPI (native messaging hosts are OS-level executables, registered via a manifest under ~/Library/Application Support/Mozilla/NativeMessagingHosts/). There is no prebuilt or signed installer — it is a power-user/beta feature that users build from source themselves.
- Full source of the helper is in the public repository under native/: https://github.com/cshintov/streaming-ad-muter/tree/master/native
    - admute-detector: Python (standard library only) native-messaging host; runs the detection state machine and exchanges length-prefixed JSON over stdio.
    - tapmon.swift: Core Audio process tap that captures system audio output (macOS 14.4+, no kernel extension or driver).
    - install.sh: compiles tapmon (requires Xcode command line tools) and registers the native-messaging host manifest.

PRIVACY / DATA
- Audio is analysed entirely locally and is never stored or transmitted. The helper computes only two scalar features per analysis window (a frequency-band energy ratio and a loudness variance) to decide ad vs content.
- The extension never receives any audio — only small JSON control messages such as {"type":"ad"} / {"type":"content"}.
- Accordingly, data_collection_permissions is declared as "none".

EXTENSION SOURCE
- The extension ships hand-written, unminified JavaScript with no bundler, minifier, or transpiler step. The entire project (extension + native helper) is public at https://github.com/cshintov/streaming-ad-muter

Happy to provide anything else needed.
